claim: A Nature Immunology study reported a longitudinal single-cell atlas of anti-TNF treatment across immune-mediated inflammatory diseases, providing cross-disease cellular treatment-response context.
future_grounding_route: Use only as segregated treatment-response atlas context unless accessible cell-state data are mapped to the project's IFN/APC and APC-axis modules under predefined disease-pair comparisons.
project_use: External context for cross-disease treatment-response structure and transfer caution; not evidence for any project module response.
relationship_note: This source supports the existence of cross-disease cellular treatment-response mapping as a valid question type, but it does not by itself confirm the project's Crohn IFN/APC transfer result.

source.citation: A longitudinal single-cell atlas of anti-tumour necrosis factor treatment in immune-mediated inflammatory diseases. Nature Immunology. 2024.
source.label: Nature Immunology longitudinal anti-TNF single-cell atlas

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: PubMed bibliographic metadata and short paraphrase only
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores bibliographic metadata and a short paraphrased claim only; do not redistribute article text or treat it as project-grounded evidence.

why_unverifiable: The project has not imported and rerun the external single-cell atlas under project module definitions.
